title: Baingan Bharta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Oil rimmed baking sheet; place eggplant halves, cut side down, on sheet.
Roast eggplant until flesh is soft, about 1 hour.
Cool slightly.
Using spoon, scoop pulp from eggplant halves into medium bowl and mash.
Discard skins.
Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, for about 6 minutes.
Add ginger and stir for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and next 4 ingredients. Sauté for 5 minutes to blend flavors.
Add eggplant and stir until slightly thickened (about 5 minutes).
Remove from heat.
Stir in cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Aloo Gobi
ingredients: 1large onion, peeled and cut into small pieces
1bunch fresh coriander, separated into stalks and leaves and roughly chopped
1small green chili, chopped into small pieces (or one teaspoon chili powder)
1large cauliflower, leaves removed and cut evenly into eighths
3large potatoes, peeled and cut into even pieces
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large saucepan.
Add the chopped onion and one teaspoon of cumin seeds to the oil.
Stir together and cook until onions become creamy, golden, and translucent.
Add chopped coriander stalks, two teaspoons of turmeric, and one teaspoon of salt.
Add chopped chillis (according to taste) Stir tomatoes into onion mixture.
Add ginger and garlic; mix thoroughly.
Add potatoes and cauliflower to the sauce plus a few tablespoons of water (ensuring that the mixture doesn't stick to the saucepan).
Ensure that the potatoes and cauliflower are coated with the curry sauce.
Cover and allow to simmer for twenty minutes (or until potatoes are cooked).
Add two teaspoons of Garam Masala and stir.
Sprinkle chopped coriander leaves on top of the curry.
Turn off the heat, cover, and leave for as long as possible before serving.

title: Chana Masala
instructions: Cut onion, tomato and green chili. Grind it in food processor along with ginger and garlic and make paste.
Heat oil in a pan and fry bay leaves for 30 secs.
Add the paste and fry on medium heat until golden brown (The oil starts separating from the mixture).
Add red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt. Mix well. Fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add water enough to make thick gravy. Bring the gravy to boil.
Add can chick peas. Stir well and cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes.
Garnish with chopped green coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Bharwa Bhindi (Stuffed Okra)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon dried mango powder also known as amchur
instructions: Wash the bhindi and let it dry. I often use a paper towel to pat dry them. Then make a cut in each bhindi lengthwise without cutting through the entire length. They should still be joint at one end. Do this with every bhindi and then set them aside.
To a large bowl add desiccated coconut powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, dried mango powder (amchur), red chili powder, garam masala, turmeric powder and salt.
Mix all the spices together with a spoon. Then add 2 teaspoons of oil to the stuffing and mix it well with the spices. The stuffing for the bhindi is now ready.
Take one bhindi and stuff it with the prepared masala. Repeat with the remaining bhindis. Make sure to stuff them well with a generous amount of masala. Set them aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan on medium heat. Place the stuffed bhindi in a single layer in the pan. After 2 minutes, lower the heat to medium-low and cover the pan.
After 2 minutes, open the pan and carefully flip each bhindi. Cover the pan again and flip the bhindi again after 2 minutes.
Keep tossing the bhindi after every 2-3 minutes or so until it's tender and done. This will take around 15 minutes on low heat.
Serve bharwa bhindi hot with roti or paratha. You can squeeze some lemon juice on top before serving for extra tang or also garnish with cilantro.

title: Butter Chicken
instructions: Heat butter in a pan. Sauté onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook till fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates.
Add turmeric, chili powder, salt, and cashew paste. Mix and cook well.
Add cooked chicken pieces and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add cream, garam masala, and crushed kasuri methi.
Stir gently and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Kadhai Chicken
ingredients: 1 teaspoon kadhai masala or garam masala
instructions: Heat oil and sauté onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add spices and chicken. Cook until done.
Add capsicum, stir-fry for 2–3 minutes.
Simmer until oil separates. Serve hot.

title: Lauki Kofta
ingredients: 2 cups grated bottle gourd (lauki), peeled and squeezed to remove excess water
2 tablespoons cream or 1/4 cup milk (optional, for richness)
instructions: Mix grated lauki, besan, ginger, green chili, and salt in a bowl to form a soft dough.
Shape the mixture into small round balls (koftas).
Heat oil in a deep pan and fry the koftas on medium heat until golden brown. Set aside.
For the gravy, heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan and add cumin seeds.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw smell disappears.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates.
Mix in turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add a little water to adjust the consistency of the gravy and bring to a boil.
Add cream or milk if using, and stir well.
Gently place the fried koftas into the gravy just before serving. Let them simmer for 2–3 minutes.
Sprinkle garam masala and garnish with chopped coriander leaves.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let rest before serving with rice or roti.

title: Chicken 65
instructions: Marinate chicken with flours, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, salt, and egg.
Let it rest for 30 minutes.
Deep fry the chicken until golden and crisp.
In another pan, heat a little oil, add curry leaves and green chilies.
Toss the fried chicken in this tempering and serve hot.

title: Mutton Rogan Josh
instructions: Heat oil, sauté onions till golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook.
Add mutton and cook until browned.
Add yogurt, spices, salt, and stir.
Add water, cover and cook until meat is tender.
Simmer until oil floats on top and gravy thickens. Serve hot.

title: Andhra Chicken Fry
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dry red chilies, and curry leaves.
Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté until raw smell goes.
Add chicken pieces, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt. Mix well.
Cover and cook on low heat until chicken is tender, stirring occasionally.
Once cooked, open the lid and fry until the chicken is dry and roasted.
Sprinkle garam masala and mix well.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
ingredients: 1 cup dried kidney beans (rajma), soaked overnight
instructions: Pressure cook soaked rajma with salt and 3–4 cups of water for 4–5 whistles or until soft. Set aside.
Heat oil or ghee in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook until raw smell disappears.
Add tomato puree and cook until the oil begins to separate.
Mix in turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and salt. Cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add cooked rajma along with the water from the pressure cooker.
Mash a few beans gently with the back of a spoon to thicken the curry.
Simmer on low heat for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add garam masala and stir well.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Mutton Keema Curry
instructions: Heat oil, sauté onions till golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chili powder.
Add tomatoes and cook till soft.
Add keema and salt. Stir well.
Add water and cook covered for 25–30 mins.
Uncover, cook until dry and garnish with coriander.

title: Palak Paneer
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach (palak), washed and chopped
instructions: Blanch spinach in hot water for 2–3 minutes, then transfer to cold water.
Blend the spinach with green chilies into a smooth puree and set aside.
Heat oil or ghee in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook until raw smell disappears.
Add tomato puree, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook until oil separates.
Pour in the spinach puree and mix well. Cook for 5–7 minutes on medium heat.
Add paneer cubes and stir gently to coat with the gravy. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add garam masala and cream (if using), stir well.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let it rest before serving.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Blend soaked cashews with a little water into a smooth paste. Set aside.
Heat oil and butter in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook until raw smell disappears.
Add tomato puree and cook until the oil separates.
Mix in turmeric, red chili powder, sugar, and salt. Cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add the cashew paste and mix well. Cook on low heat for 4–5 minutes.
Add milk or cream and stir continuously to make a smooth, rich gravy.
Gently add paneer cubes and simmer for 5–7 minutes.
Sprinkle garam masala and chopped coriander leaves.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Bhuna Gosht
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy pan, add cumin seeds.
Add chopped onions and sauté till golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté until raw smell fades.
Add mutton and cook until browned.
Add turmeric, chili, coriander powders and salt. Mix well.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add yogurt and stir till oil separates.
Cover and cook on low flame until mutton is tender.
Uncover and bhunao (fry) the mutton until the gravy thickens and sticks to meat.
Sprinkle garam masala and garnish with coriander.

title: Dum Aloo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oil or ghee (for cooking the gravy)
instructions: Boil the peeled baby potatoes until just tender. Prick them gently with a fork.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan and shallow-fry the potatoes until golden brown. Set aside.
In a large pan, heat oil or ghee. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add finely chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook until raw smell disappears.
Add tomato puree and cook until the oil begins to separate.
Mix in turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce the heat and slowly stir in the whisked yogurt, mixing continuously to avoid curdling.
Cook on low heat until the gravy thickens and oil separates.
Add the fried potatoes to the gravy and mix to coat well.
Pour in 1/2 cup water (adjust for desired consistency), cover, and cook on low flame for 15–20 minutes.
Sprinkle garam masala and chopped coriander leaves.
Turn off heat, cover, and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Heat oil and sauté onions until brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook.
Add turmeric, chili, and coriander powders.
Add tomato puree and cook till oil separates.
Add chicken and salt, mix and cook on medium flame.
Add water, cover and simmer until chicken is tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and serve hot.

title: Methi Malai Matar
ingredients: 1/4 cup cashews, soaked in warm water for 15 minutes
instructions: Grind soaked cashews with a little water to make a smooth paste. Set aside.
Heat oil or ghee in a pan and add cumin seeds. Let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until they turn golden brown.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and green chilies; cook until raw smell goes away.
Add chopped methi leaves and sauté for 3–4 minutes until they wilt.
Mix in turmeric, coriander powder, and pepper. Stir well.
Add the prepared cashew paste and cook for 2–3 minutes on low heat.
Pour in milk and bring to a gentle simmer. Stir continuously to avoid curdling.
Add boiled green peas and salt. Mix well.
Cook for 5–7 minutes on low heat until peas absorb the flavors.
Add fresh cream and garam masala. Stir gently and simmer for 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let it rest covered for a few minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, and ginger-garlic paste.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until charred and cooked.
Heat butter, sauté onion, add tomato puree, and cook till thick.
Add cream, sugar, and grilled chicken.
Simmer for 10–15 minutes and serve hot.

title: Chicken Chettinad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons Chettinad masala (or homemade spice mix)
instructions: Heat oil and sauté onions, curry leaves until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook until raw smell goes.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add turmeric, chili powder, Chettinad masala, and salt.
Add chicken and mix well. Cook covered on low flame until done.
Fry uncovered for a few minutes until oil separates. Serve hot.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork
ingredients: 1 pound pork loin, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Marinate pork pieces in beaten egg, then coat evenly with cornstarch.
Heat oil in a deep fryer or large pan to 350°F (175°C). Fry pork pieces until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels.
In a saucepan, combine ketchup, rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, and pineapple juice. Bring to a boil.
Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until sauce thickens.
In a separate pan, stir-fry bell peppers and onion until slightly tender.
Add fried pork and pineapple chunks to the vegetables. Pour sauce over and toss to coat.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Twice-Cooked Pork (Hui Guo Rou)
instructions: Place pork belly in a pot of water and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove and let cool. Slice thinly.
Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add garlic and ginger; sauté until fragrant.
Add pork slices and stir-fry until browned.
Stir in broad bean paste, soy sauce, and Shaoxing wine. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add bell pepper and green onions; stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Baked Brie with Honey and Nuts
ingredients: Crackers or sliced baguette for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Place Brie on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle honey over the top and sprinkle with chopped nuts and thyme leaves.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until Brie is soft and melty.
Serve warm with crackers or baguette slices.

title: Harissa Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 3 cups mixed vegetables (carrots, bell peppers, zucchini, cauliflower)
Fresh cilantro or parsley for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a large bowl, toss vegetables with olive oil, harissa paste, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast for 30–35 minutes, stirring halfway through, until vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or parsley and serve warm

title: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into bite-sized florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, water, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Toss cauliflower florets in the batter until fully coated. Shake off excess batter and place florets on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
In a small bowl, mix hot sauce and melted butter.
Remove cauliflower from oven, toss with buffalo sauce, and return to oven for 10 more minutes.
Serve hot with ranch or blue cheese dressing.

title: 5-Ingredient Quesadilla
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cheese (cheddar, mozzarella, or mix)
1/2 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat and lightly grease with cooking spray or butter.
Place one tortilla in the skillet. Sprinkle half the cheese evenly over it.
Add black beans and spoon salsa over the cheese.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top, then place the second tortilla over everything.
Cook for 2–3 minutes until the bottom tortilla is golden and cheese starts to melt.
Carefully flip and cook the other side until golden and cheese is fully melted.
Remove, cut into wedges, and serve.

title: Chow Mein
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles or chow mein noodles
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and onion, stir-fry until fragrant.
Add cabbage and carrots; stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add bean sprouts and green onions; cook for 1 minute.
Add noodles to the wok.
Stir in soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper. Toss everything together and cook for another 2–3 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Deviled Eggs with a Kick
ingredients: Paprika or chopped chives for garnish
instructions: Place eggs in a single layer in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then remove from heat and cover. Let sit for 12 minutes.
Drain and cool eggs under cold running water. Peel and slice eggs in half lengthwise.
Remove yolks and place in a bowl. Mash yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, hot sauce, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Spoon or pipe yolk mixture back into egg whites.
Garnish with paprika or chives.
Chill until ready to serve.

title: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 500 grams chicken (bone-in, cut into medium pieces)
A few strands of saffron soaked in 2 tablespoons warm milk (optional)
instructions: Wash and soak basmati rice for 30 minutes. Drain before cooking.

In a large bowl, marinate the chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, biryani masala, garam masala, lemon juice, green chilies, mint, coriander, and salt. Marinate for at least 1 hour.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil or ghee in a pan. Fry sliced onions until golden brown and crisp. Set half aside for layering.
In the same pan, add marinated chicken and cook on medium heat for 10–12 minutes until partially cooked. Do not dry it out.
In another pot, boil 4 cups of water with salt, cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon, and bay leaf. Add soaked rice and cook until 70–80% done. Drain and keep aside.
In a deep biryani pot, spread a layer of chicken with some gravy.
Add a layer of partially cooked rice on top.
Sprinkle the reserved fried onions, saffron milk (if using), and a little ghee over the rice.
Cover the pot with a tight lid. Cook on low flame (dum) for 25–30 minutes. You can also place a heavy object on the lid to seal the steam.
Turn off the heat and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Gently fluff and serve hot with raita or salan.

title: Lazy Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chicken or tofu (pre-cooked or store-bought)
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add frozen vegetables and stir-fry until heated through, about 5–7 minutes.
Add cooked chicken or tofu, soy sauce, and garlic powder. Stir well to combine and cook for another 3 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice or noodles if desired.

title: Baked Sweet Potato
ingredients: Optional toppings: butter, sour cream, shredded cheese, chives
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Pierce sweet potato several times with a fork.
Rub with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Place directly on oven rack or baking sheet.
Bake for 45–50 minutes until tender when pierced with a fork.
Slice open, add toppings as desired, and serve.

title: Greek Salad Skewers
instructions: Wash the cherry tomatoes thoroughly and pat them dry.
Peel the cucumber if desired and slice it into approximately 1/4-inch thick rounds. Set aside.
Cut the feta cheese into small cubes, roughly the same size as the cherry tomatoes and cucumber slices.
Drain the Kalamata olives and pat them dry with a paper towel to avoid excess moisture.
Take a skewer or toothpick and thread the ingredients in this order: one cherry tomato, one cucumber slice, one feta cube, and one Kalamata olive. Repeat until all skewers are assembled.
Arrange the completed skewers neatly on a serving platter, spacing them evenly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, dried oregano, salt, and pepper until well combined to make the dressing.
Just before serving, drizzle the dressing evenly over the skewers to add flavor and a slight gloss.
Optionally, garnish the platter with fresh oregano or parsley for a pop of color.
Serve immediately to enjoy the fresh flavors and crisp textures.

title: New England Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 cans (6.5 oz each) chopped clams with juice
2 cups clam juice or seafood broth
instructions: In a large pot, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon and set aside, leaving the fat in the pot.
Add onion, garlic, and celery to the pot; cook until softened.
Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.
Gradually whisk in clam juice and clam broth to avoid lumps.
Add potatoes and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15–20 minutes.
Stir in clams (with their juice) and cream. Heat gently without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with cooked bacon and chopped parsley before serving.

title: Lemon Rice
ingredients: Juice of 1 large lemon (adjust to taste)
1 tablespoon chopped coriander leaves (optional, for garnish)
instructions: Cook rice and allow it to cool completely. Fluff it gently to separate the grains.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal and chana dal. Fry until golden brown.
Add dried red chilies, green chilies, curry leaves, and a pinch of asafoetida. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Add turmeric powder and peanuts or cashews. Mix well.
Turn off the heat and add lemon juice. Stir to combine.
Add the cooked rice and salt. Mix gently so that the rice is evenly coated with the lemon- spice mixture.
Taste and adjust lemon juice or salt as needed.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves if desired. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Crispy Jackfruit Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups canned young green jackfruit, drained and shredded
Fresh cilantro and lemon wedges for serving
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine chickpea flour, all-purpose flour, cumin seeds, chili powder, turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Gradually add water to the dry mix, stirring until you get a thick batter (not too runny).
Stir in the shredded jackfruit, chopped onion, and garlic until everything is well coated with the batter.
Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter mixture into the hot oil, flattening slightly with the back of the spoon. Fry in batches.
Cook each fritter for about 3–4 minutes per side or until golden brown and crispy.
Use a slotted spoon to remove fritters and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lemon wedges on the side.

title: Mediterranean Hummus Platter
ingredients: Pita bread or pita chips for serving
instructions: Spread hummus on a large serving platter or shallow bowl.
Arrange cherry tomatoes, cucumber slices, olives, and feta cheese over the hummus.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Serve immediately with pita bread or pita chips for dipping.

title: Instant Pot Chili
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Set Instant Pot to sauté mode. Brown the ground meat with diced onion until no longer pink.
Add beans, tomatoes, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Close lid, seal valve, and cook on high pressure for 10 minutes.
Quick-release pressure, stir, and serve hot.

title: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 pound flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
instructions: Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl until smooth. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Stir-fry broccoli for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp. Remove and set aside.
Heat remaining oil, add garlic and ginger; sauté until fragrant.
Add beef and cook until browned.
Return broccoli to pan, pour in sauce, and stir to coat. Cook until sauce thickens, about 2- 3 minutes.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Spinach and Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 (14 oz) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
Tortilla chips, bread, or veggies for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, mozzarella, Parmesan, and garlic until smooth.
Fold in spinach and artichokes, then season with salt and pepper.
Transfer mixture to a baking dish and spread evenly.
Bake for 25 minutes until bubbly and golden on top.
Serve warm with chips, bread, or fresh veggies.

title: Firecracker Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, sriracha, and rice vinegar. Set aside.
Pat shrimp dry with paper towels and coat evenly in cornstarch.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry shrimp for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels.
Toss shrimp in the prepared sauce until coated.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately with steamed rice or noodles.

title: Cajun Blackened Fish
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional for extra heat)
instructions: Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix Cajun seasoning, paprika, and cayenne pepper.
Brush fish fillets with melted butter on both sides.
Coat fillets evenly with the seasoning mixture.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add fillets and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until blackened and cooked through.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and your choice of side.

title: Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 cup (2 sticks) cold unsalted butter, cut into cubes
6 cups thinly sliced, peeled apples (Granny Smith or tart apples)
instructions: To make the crust, combine flour, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add ice water, 1 tablespoon at a time, mixing until dough just comes together.
Divide dough in half, shape into disks, wrap in plastic wrap, and chill for at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a large bowl, mix sliced apples, sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon juice.
Roll out one dough disk on a floured surface and fit into a 9-inch pie dish.
Pour apple filling into the crust.
Roll out second dough disk and place over filling. Trim and crimp edges to seal.
Cut slits in the top crust for steam to escape.
Bake for 15 minutes at 425°F, then reduce temperature to 350°F (175°C) and bake for 40–50 minutes until crust is golden and filling is bubbly.
Let cool before serving.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add beaten eggs and scramble until cooked. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the pan. Sauté onion and garlic until fragrant and translucent.
Add mixed vegetables and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add cooked rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.
Return cooked eggs to the pan and mix well.
Add soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve hot.

title: French Fries
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut them into ¼-inch thick sticks.
Soak the cut potatoes in cold water for at least 30 minutes to remove excess starch.
Drain and pat dry thoroughly with a clean towel.
Heat oil in a deep fryer or large pot to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the potatoes in batches for 3–4 minutes until they are soft but not browned. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the potatoes again in batches for 2–3 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
Immediately season with salt to taste and serve hot.

title: Shrimp Cocktail Platter
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Fill a large pot with water, add lemon slices, garlic cloves, bay leaf, and salt. Bring to a boil.
Add shrimp to the boiling water and cook for 2–3 minutes until they turn pink and are opaque. Do not overcook.
Prepare a large bowl of ice water. Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp immediately to the ice bath to stop cooking. Let them chill for about 5 minutes.
Drain shrimp and pat dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, combine ketchup, horseradish, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, and hot sauce to make the cocktail sauce. Mix well and adjust seasoning to taste.
Arrange shrimp on a serving platter, preferably over a bed of ice or lettuce to keep chilled.
Place a bowl of cocktail sauce in the center or alongside the shrimp for dipping.
Garnish with lemon wedges and fresh parsley if desired.
Serve immediately or keep chilled until party time.

title: Jalapeño Popper Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced jalapeños (pickled or fresh, adjust heat)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, combine cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, jalapeños, bacon bits, garlic powder, and onion powder. Mix well.
Transfer mixture to a baking dish and spread evenly.
Bake for 20 minutes or until bubbly and golden on top.
Serve warm with tortilla chips, crackers, or sliced veggies.

title: BBQ Pulled Jackfruit Sliders
ingredients: 2 cans young green jackfruit in water or brine (not syrup), drained and rinsed
instructions: Drain and rinse the jackfruit well. Use your hands or forks to shred the jackfruit into pieces resembling pulled pork. Remove any hard seeds.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shredded jackfruit to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in BBQ sauce, smoked paprika, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Mix well to coat the jackfruit evenly.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Add a splash of water if it gets too dry.
Toast slider buns lightly.
Assemble sliders by piling BBQ jackfruit onto buns and topping with coleslaw if desired. Serve warm.

title: Sweet and Spicy Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, chopped onion, garlic, milk, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix until just combined.
Form mixture into 1-inch meatballs and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake meatballs for 20–25 minutes until cooked through and browned.
Meanwhile, in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk together barbecue sauce, honey, sriracha, and soy sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove meatballs from the oven and transfer them to the saucepan with the sauce. Toss gently to coat all meatballs evenly.
Cook meatballs in the sauce for an additional 5 minutes to absorb flavors.
Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with chopped green onions or sesame seeds if desired.
Serve warm with toothpicks for easy party snacking.

title: Thai Red Curry with Chicken
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast, sliced thin
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat.
Add red curry paste and stir-fry for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Add sliced chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Pour in coconut milk and chicken broth, stirring to combine.
Add bell peppers and zucchini; cook for 5–6 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in fish sauce and brown sugar; adjust seasoning as needed.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves and serve hot over steamed rice.

title: Philly Cheesesteak
ingredients: 1 lb thinly sliced ribeye steak or sirloin
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onions and bell peppers; sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add steak slices, season with salt and pepper, and cook until browned.
Return onions and peppers to the skillet and mix with the steak.
Divide the mixture evenly onto hoagie rolls.
Place two slices of provolone cheese on top of the meat mixture in each roll.
Optional: place sandwiches under a broiler for 1–2 minutes to melt the cheese.
Serve hot.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 package (14.1 oz) refrigerated pie crusts (2 crusts)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add onions and cook until soft.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper. Cook and stir for 1–2 minutes.
Gradually stir in chicken broth and milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in chicken and frozen peas and carrots. Remove from heat.
Roll out one pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie plate.
Pour chicken mixture into crust.
Cover with second pie crust; seal and flute edges. Cut slits in the top crust for steam to escape.
Bake for 30–35 minutes or until crust is golden brown.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Southern Collard Greens
ingredients: 2 pounds collard greens, washed and chopped
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large pot, cook chopped bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove bacon and set aside, leaving the fat in the pot.
Add onion to the pot and sauté until translucent.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add collard greens and stir until wilted.
Pour in chicken broth, apple cider vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes if using.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1 hour or until greens are tender.
Stir in cooked bacon before serving.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together garlic, anchovies, mustard, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise, Parmesan, salt, and pepper until smooth.
In a large salad bowl, toss the chopped Romaine with the dressing until evenly coated.
Add croutons and additional Parmesan cheese on top.
Serve immediately.

title: Tomato Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal and chana dal. Fry until golden brown.
Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Add green chilies and ginger-garlic paste. Sauté until raw smell disappears.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes are soft and oil starts to separate.
Stir in garam masala and curry leaves. Cook for another 2 minutes.
Add cooked rice and mix gently to coat the rice evenly with the tomato mixture.
Cook for 3–4 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally.
Turn off the heat, add chopped coriander and lemon juice if using, and mix well.
Serve hot.

title: Shrimp and Grits
instructions: Bring water and salt to a boil in a saucepan. Slowly whisk in grits. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened (about 25–30 minutes). Stir in butter and cheddar cheese, then keep warm.
In a skillet, cook bacon until crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels, leaving some bacon fat in the pan.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté until soft.
Add shrimp, season with salt and pepper, and cook until pink and cooked through (about 3–4 minutes).
Stir in lemon juice and green onions.
Serve shrimp mixture over creamy grits and garnish with cooked bacon.

title: Mutton Biryani
ingredients: 500 grams mutton (bone-in, cut into medium pieces)
A few saffron strands soaked in 2 tablespoons warm milk (optional)
instructions: Rinse and soak basmati rice for 30 minutes. Drain before cooking.

In a bowl, marinate the mutton with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, biryani masala, lemon juice, green chilies, mint, coriander, and salt. Let it marinate for at least 1 hour (preferably overnight).
In a pressure cooker or deep pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil or ghee. Fry sliced onions until golden brown and crisp. Set half aside for layering.
Add the marinated mutton and cook for 15–20 minutes, or pressure cook for 2–3 whistles until the meat is tender.
In another pot, boil 4 cups of water with salt, cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon, and bay leaf. Add soaked rice and cook until 70–80% done. Drain and keep aside.
In a large heavy-bottomed biryani pot, spread a layer of cooked mutton with some gravy.
Add a layer of partially cooked rice on top.
Sprinkle the reserved fried onions, saffron milk (if using), and a drizzle of ghee.
Cover the pot tightly with a lid. Cook on low heat (dum) for 25–30 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Gently fluff and serve hot with raita or salan.

title: Vegetable Biryani
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, beans, peas, potatoes, cauliflower), chopped
instructions: Rinse and soak basmati rice for 20-30 minutes. Drain.
In a large pot, bring 3 cups water to boil with salt, cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon, and bay leaf. Add rice and cook until 70–80% done. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil or ghee in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté until raw smell disappears.
Add chopped tomatoes, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt, and cook until tomatoes soften.
Stir in yogurt, biryani masala, and garam masala. Mix well.
Add mixed vegetables and cook until slightly tender but not mushy.
In a deep pot, layer half the cooked rice, then the vegetable mixture, followed by the remaining rice.
Sprinkle chopped coriander and mint leaves on top.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 20-25 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let it rest for 10 minutes before gently fluffing the biryani.
Serve hot with raita or salad.

title: Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 pound chicken thighs, boneless and skinless, diced
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add sausage and cook until browned. Remove and set aside.
Add chicken to the pot and cook until browned. Remove and set aside with sausage.
In the same pot, sauté onion, bell pepper, celery, and garlic until softened.
Stir in diced tomatoes, rice, Cajun seasoning, thyme, bay leaves, salt, and pepper.
Return sausage and chicken to the pot. Pour in chicken broth and stir well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 25–30 minutes or until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Remove bay leaves, fluff rice, and serve hot.

title: Hot and Sour Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup tofu, cut into small cubes
1 teaspoon chili paste or chili oil (adjust to taste)
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot.
Add mushrooms, bamboo shoots, tofu, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili paste, and white pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until soup thickens.
Slowly drizzle beaten egg into the soup while stirring gently to create egg ribbons.
Add chopped green onions and adjust salt if needed.
Serve hot.

title: Vindaloo Lamb Curry
ingredients: 2 pounds lamb shoulder, cut into cubes
1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional, for extra heat)
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in garlic and ginger; cook for 1 minute.
Add vindaloo paste, cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper; stir until fragrant.
Add lamb cubes and brown on all sides.
Stir in chopped tomatoes and cook until softened.
Pour in broth and vinegar, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 1–1.5 hours until lamb is tender.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Mapo Tofu
ingredients: 400 grams (14 oz) soft tofu, cut into cubes
1 tablespoon fermented black beans, rinsed and chopped
1 teaspoon Sichuan peppercorns, toasted and ground
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic, ginger, doubanjiang, and fermented black beans; stir-fry until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook until browned.
Pour in chicken broth, soy sauce, and sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Gently add tofu cubes and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Sprinkle ground Sichuan peppercorns and chopped green onions.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: General Tso’s Chicken
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1/2 teaspoon red chili flakes (adjust to taste)
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
instructions: Coat chicken pieces evenly in cornstarch.
Heat oil in a deep fryer or large pan to 350°F (175°C). Fry chicken until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
In a saucepan, combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger, and chili flakes. Bring to a simmer.
Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until sauce thickens.
Toss fried chicken in the sauce until well coated.
Serve hot with steamed rice and garnish with green onions if desired.

title: Coconut Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon coconut oil or vegetable oil
2–3 dried red chilies, broken into halves
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice thoroughly in water until the water runs clear.
Cook the rice with 1½ cups of water. Let it cool and fluff it with a fork.
In a pan, heat coconut oil on medium flame.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal and chana dal. Fry until golden brown.
Add dried red chilies, green chilies, curry leaves, and a pinch of asafoetida. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Add grated coconut and sauté for 2–3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cooked rice and salt. Mix gently so the coconut mixture is evenly distributed.
Cook on low flame for 2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let it sit for a few minutes before serving.

title: Kashmiri Pulao
ingredients: 2–3 tablespoons pomegranate seeds (or apple cubes or grapes)
1 pinch saffron strands soaked in 1 tablespoon warm milk (optional)
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice until water runs clear. Soak for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat ghee in a pot. Add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, bay leaf, and cumin seeds. Sauté for a few seconds until aromatic.
Add sliced onion and sauté until light golden.
Add drained rice and sauté gently for 2–3 minutes.
Add water, fennel powder (if using), saffron milk, and salt. Stir well.
Cover and cook on low heat until rice is cooked and water is absorbed (about 15–18 minutes).
Meanwhile, in a separate pan, lightly fry raisins, cashews, and almonds in ghee until golden. Set aside.
Once rice is done, fluff it gently with a fork.
Mix in the fried nuts, raisins, and pomegranate seeds (or fruits of choice).
Serve warm, optionally garnished with more dry fruits and fresh fruits.

title: Jalapeño Popper Dip
ingredients: Tortilla chips or crackers for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream, cheddar cheese, bacon, jalapeños, green onions, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Spread the mixture into a baking dish.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until bubbly and golden on top.
Serve warm with tortilla chips or crackers.

title: Lo Mein
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles or lo mein noodles
1 cup snap peas or snow peas
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add mushrooms, bell peppers, snap peas, and carrot; stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.
Add cooked noodles to the wok.
Stir in soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper. Toss everything together and cook for another 2–3 minutes until heated through.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve hot.

title: Sheet Pan Nachos
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cheese (cheddar or Mexican blend)
1/2 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed
Sour cream and salsa for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Spread tortilla chips evenly on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle shredded cheese, black beans, diced tomatoes, and jalapeños over the chips.
Bake for 10–12 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve with sour cream and salsa.

title: Cajun Shrimp Skewers
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, toss shrimp with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Thread shrimp onto soaked bamboo skewers, about 4–5 shrimp per skewer.
Grill skewers for 2–3 minutes per side until shrimp are opaque and cooked through.
Remove from grill and arrange on a serving platter.
Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over the shrimp.

title: Chipotle Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
2 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced
Toppings: shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, avocado slices, sour cream, shredded cheese
instructions: In a bowl, combine chipotle peppers, olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Add chicken strips and toss to coat. Marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken for 6–8 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave.
Fill tortillas with chicken and desired toppings.
Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.

title: BBQ Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, onion, garlic, milk, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Form mixture into 1-inch meatballs and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until cooked through.
Transfer meatballs to a large saucepan, add BBQ sauce, and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve warm with toothpicks for easy eating.

title: Pancakes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons melted butter or vegetable oil
instructions: In a large bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
Make a well in the center and pour in milk, egg, and melted butter. Mix until smooth.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Pour or scoop about 1/4 cup batter onto the griddle for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook the other side until golden brown.
Serve hot with maple syrup, butter, or your favorite toppings.

title: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add beaten eggs and scramble until cooked. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil, garlic, and onion; sauté until fragrant and translucent.
Add peas and carrots; cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.
Return eggs to the pan and mix well.
Stir in soy sauce, salt, and pepper.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.

title: Spicy Shrimp Tacos with Chipotle Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream or Greek yogurt
1-2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce (adjust heat)
instructions: Prepare the shrimp: In a bowl, toss shrimp with olive oil, chili powder, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Cook the shrimp: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Remove from heat.
Make the chipotle sauce: In a blender or food processor, combine sour cream, chipotle peppers, lime juice, and salt. Blend until smooth. Adjust heat by adding more chipotle if desired.
Warm the tortillas: Heat tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave until warm and pliable.
Assemble tacos: Spread a spoonful of chipotle sauce on each tortilla. Top with shrimp, shredded lettuce or cabbage, diced tomatoes, and cilantro.
Serve immediately with lime wedges for squeezing.

title: Meat and Cheese Charcuterie Board
ingredients: Variety of cheeses (cheddar, brie, gouda, blue cheese)
Fresh and dried fruits (grapes, figs, apricots)
instructions: Arrange cured meats and cheeses on a large platter or wooden board.
Fill in gaps with crackers, sliced baguette, fruits, nuts, olives, and pickles.
Add small bowls of honey or fig jam for dipping.
Serve at room temperature for best flavor.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken and Veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss chicken and veggies with olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Spread everything on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast for 30–35 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender.
Serve hot.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced
instructions: In a bowl, marinate chicken with soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, and cornstarch for 15 minutes.
Mix all sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add dried chilies and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through. Remove and set aside.
Add garlic and ginger to the wok; stir-fry briefly.
Return chicken to the wok along with the sauce. Stir until sauce thickens.
Stir in roasted peanuts and green onions.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: BBQ Ribs
ingredients: 2 racks pork ribs (baby back or spare ribs)
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C).
In a small bowl, mix brown sugar, paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and cayenne.
Remove the thin membrane from the back of the ribs.
Rub the spice mixture all over the ribs.
Wrap the ribs tightly in aluminum foil and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 2 to 2.5 hours until tender.
Remove ribs from foil and brush with BBQ sauce.
Optional: Grill or broil ribs for 5–7 minutes to caramelize the sauce.
Serve hot with extra BBQ sauce on the side.

title: Microwave Mug Omelette
instructions: In a microwave-safe mug, whisk eggs and milk until combined.
Stir in salt, pepper, cheese, and vegetables if using.
Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes, stopping halfway to stir.
Cook until eggs are set and fully cooked.
Carefully remove from microwave (mug will be hot) and enjoy.

title: Buffalo Wings
ingredients: Celery sticks and blue cheese dressing for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Pat chicken wings dry and season with salt and pepper.
Place wings on a baking sheet lined with foil and wire rack if available. Bake for 40–45 minutes, turning halfway, until crispy and cooked through.
Meanwhile, in a saucepan, melt butter over low heat.
Stir in hot sauce, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and cayenne pepper. Heat gently until combined.
Toss the cooked wings in the sauce until fully coated.
Serve hot with celery sticks and blue cheese dressing on the side.

title: Spicy Korean Chicken Stir-Fry (Dak Galbi)
ingredients: 1 pound boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade. Mix well.
Add chicken pieces to the marinade and toss to coat evenly. Let marinate for at least 20 minutes (or up to 2 hours for deeper flavor).
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add onions and stir- fry until translucent (about 3 minutes).
Add marinated chicken along with all the marinade sauce. Cook, stirring frequently, until the chicken is mostly cooked (about 8–10 minutes).
Add cabbage and carrot. Stir-fry everything together until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through (about 5 more minutes).
Add chopped green onions and cook for another 1–2 minutes.
Remove from heat, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve hot with steamed rice or noodles.

title: Habanero Mango Salsa
ingredients: 1–2 habanero peppers, finely minced (remove seeds for less heat)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine diced mangoes, habanero peppers, onion, and bell pepper.
Add chopped cilantro and lime juice.
Toss gently to mix all ingredients.
Season with salt to taste.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving for best flavor.
Serve with tortilla chips, tacos, or grilled meats.

title: Spicy Thai Basil Beef (Pad Kra Pao)**
ingredients: 3 Thai bird’s eye chilies (or to taste), finely chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add minced garlic and chopped chilies, stir-fry until fragrant (about 30 seconds).
Add ground beef and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, breaking up clumps as you go.
Add sliced onion and cook for 2–3 minutes until slightly softened.
Stir in soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar. Mix well to combine.
Add fresh basil leaves and cook just until wilted, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Serve over jasmine rice and top with a fried egg if desired.

title: Korean Gochujang Chicken
ingredients: 1 ½ pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
instructions: In a large bowl, combine gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, honey, garlic, and ginger.
Add chicken pieces and toss to coat. Marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add marinated chicken and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked and slightly charred.
Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice or lettuce wraps.

title: Classic Cheeseburger
instructions: Preheat grill or skillet to medium-high heat.
Divide ground beef into 4 equal portions and shape into patties slightly larger than the buns.
Season patties with salt and pepper on both sides.
Cook patties for about 4 minutes on each side or until desired doneness.
Place a slice of cheese on each patty during the last minute of cooking; cover to melt.
Toast buns lightly on the grill or skillet.
Assemble burgers with lettuce, tomato, pickles, and condiments as desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Cornbread
ingredients: 1/4 cup melted butter or vegetable oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, beat eggs and then stir in milk and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour batter into a greased 8-inch square baking pan.
Bake for 20–25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let cool slightly before cutting and serving.

title: Spicy Cajun Chicken
instructions: Rub chicken breasts with Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 6–7 minutes per side or until cooked through.
Let rest for a few minutes before slicing. Serve with rice or veggies.

title: Tamarind Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tamarind paste (or 1 small lemon-sized ball of tamarind soaked and extracted)
instructions: If using tamarind ball, soak it in warm water for 15 minutes and extract the pulp. Otherwise, use tamarind paste diluted with some water.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add chana dal, urad dal, fenugreek seeds (if using), and fry until golden brown.
Add dried red chilies, green chilies, curry leaves, and asafoetida. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Pour in the tamarind pulp and cook for 5–7 minutes on low heat until it thickens slightly.
Add jaggery or sugar and salt to taste. Mix well and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the tamarind mixture. Mix gently so the rice is well coated.
Stir in roasted peanuts or cashews if using.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let the flavors meld for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
ingredients: Tortilla chips, celery sticks, or crackers for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a mixing bowl, combine shredded chicken, cream cheese, ranch dressing, hot sauce, and half of the cheddar cheese. Mix well.
Spread mixture into a baking dish.
Sprinkle remaining cheddar cheese and blue cheese crumbles on top.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until bubbly and hot.
Serve warm with tortilla chips, celery sticks, or crackers.

title: Egg Biryani
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and soak it in water for 20 minutes. Drain before cooking.
In a large pan, add 3 cups water and a bit of salt. Bring to boil, add soaked rice, and cook until 90% done. Drain and set aside.
In another pan, heat oil or ghee. Add cumin seeds, cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon, and bay leaf. Sauté for a few seconds.
Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a minute until raw smell goes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Stir in yogurt, red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, and biryani masala. Mix well.
Add salt, mint, and coriander leaves. Cook until oil begins to separate.
Gently score boiled eggs with a knife (optional) and add to the masala. Sauté for 2–3 minutes.
In a deep pot, layer half the rice, then the egg masala, then the rest of the rice.
Sprinkle a few coriander or mint leaves on top. Cover tightly with a lid.
Cook on very low flame (dum) for 15–20 minutes.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then gently fluff and serve hot.

title: BBQ Pulled Pork Sliders
instructions: Mix brown sugar, smoked paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Rub all over the pork shoulder.
Place pork in slow cooker. Pour apple cider vinegar over it. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours until pork is tender.
Remove pork and shred using two forks. Discard any large pieces of fat.
Mix shredded pork with BBQ sauce.
Serve on slider buns topped with coleslaw if desired.

title: Pulled Pork Sliders with Coleslaw
instructions: Mix brown sugar, smoked paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Rub this spice mix all over the pork shoulder.
Place the pork in the slow cooker and pour apple cider vinegar over it. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours until the pork is tender and easily shredded.

While pork cooks, prepare the coleslaw. In a large bowl, combine shredded cabbage and carrots. In a separate small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper. Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss well. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Once pork is cooked, remove from slow cooker and shred using two forks, discarding any large pieces of fat.
Mix shredded pork with BBQ sauce until well combined.
To assemble sliders, pile pulled pork onto slider buns and top with coleslaw.
Serve immediately for best flavor and texture.

title: Caprese Stuffed Avocados
instructions: Wash the avocados thoroughly. Cut each avocado in half lengthwise and remove the pits carefully.
Using a spoon, scoop out some of the avocado flesh from each half to create a larger cavity for the stuffing. Be careful not to scoop too much to keep the shell intact.
Chop the scooped-out avocado flesh into small pieces and transfer them to a mixing bowl.
Quarter the cherry tomatoes and halve the mozzarella balls; add them to the bowl with the chopped avocado.
Chop fresh basil leaves finely and add to the bowl.
Drizzle olive oil over the mixture, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Gently toss all ingredients in the bowl to combine, ensuring the avocado pieces don’t get too mashed.
Carefully spoon the mixture into each avocado half, filling the cavities generously.
Arrange the stuffed avocados on a serving plate.
Drizzle balsamic glaze evenly over the stuffed avocados for a touch of sweetness and presentation.
Serve immediately to enjoy the fresh flavors and creamy texture. Optionally, garnish with extra basil leaves for color.

title: Mini Caprese Skewers
instructions: Thread one cherry tomato, one basil leaf, and one mozzarella ball onto each skewer.
Arrange skewers on a serving platter.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze.
Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately or refrigerate until party time.

title: Korean BBQ Meatballs
ingredients: Sesame seeds and chopped green onions for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, garlic, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, grated ginger, breadcrumbs, and egg. Mix well.
Form mixture into 1-inch meatballs and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, combine all sauce ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes.
Toss cooked meatballs in the sauce until well coated.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve warm.

title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional, for extra heat)
Fresh thyme or cilantro for garnish
instructions: In a bowl, mix jerk seasoning, olive oil, soy sauce, garlic, lime juice, brown sugar, cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the chicken thighs. Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best flavor).
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place chicken on a baking sheet lined with foil or parchment paper.
Roast for 35–45 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and skin is crispy.
Garnish with fresh thyme or cilantro and serve with rice and peas or your favorite sides.

title: Loaded Potato Skins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Scrub potatoes clean and prick several times with a fork. Place directly on the oven rack and bake for 45 minutes or until tender.
Let potatoes cool slightly, then cut each in half lengthwise. Using a spoon, scoop out the flesh leaving about a 1/4-inch thick shell.
Brush the potato skins with olive oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Place skins skin-side down on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes until crispy.
Remove from oven and fill each skin with shredded cheddar cheese and crumbled bacon.
Return to oven and bake for another 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and top each potato skin with a dollop of sour cream and chopped green onions.
Serve warm as a hearty party appetizer.

title: Loaded Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked ground beef or shredded chicken (optional)
1/2 cup black beans, rinsed and drained
Sour cream, guacamole, and salsa for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Spread tortilla chips evenly on a large baking sheet or oven-safe platter.
Sprinkle shredded cheeses evenly over the chips.
Add cooked ground beef or chicken, black beans, jalapeños, tomatoes, and olives.
Bake for 10–15 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and garnish with chopped green onions.
Serve with sour cream, guacamole, and salsa on the side.

title: Tuna Salad Sandwich
ingredients: 1 can tuna (in water or oil), drained
instructions: In a bowl, mix tuna, mayonnaise, relish, salt, and pepper.
Spread the mixture onto one slice of bread.
Add lettuce or tomato if desired.
Top with the other slice of bread.
Serve immediately.

title: Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and green bell pepper; sauté until softened.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, kidney beans, and beef broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Adjust seasoning if needed. Serve hot, optionally with shredded cheese, sour cream, or chopped green onions.

title: Clam Bake
ingredients: 4 ears of corn, husked and cut into thirds
instructions: In a large pot or steamer, add water, white wine (if using), onion, garlic, and lemon slices. Bring to a boil.
Add potatoes and cook covered for 10 minutes.
Add sausage and corn, cover and cook for another 10 minutes.
Add clams and mussels, cover and cook until shells open, about 8–10 minutes. Discard any that do not open.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot, ideally spread out on newspaper for a classic New England feast.

title: Avocado Toast
ingredients: Optional toppings: red pepper flakes, lemon juice, olive oil, cherry tomatoes
instructions: Mash the avocado in a bowl with salt and pepper.
Spread mashed avocado evenly on toasted bread slices.
Add any optional toppings you like.
Serve immediately.

title: Jackfruit Tacos with Spicy Slaw
ingredients: 2 cans young green jackfruit in water or brine, drained and shredded
instructions: Prepare the spicy slaw by mixing cabbage, cilantro, mayonnaise, lime juice, hot sauce, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Refrigerate while preparing the jackfruit.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for another minute.
Add shredded jackfruit, cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Cook the jackfruit for 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through and slightly caramelized.
Remove from heat and squeeze lime juice over the jackfruit. Stir to combine.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave.
Assemble tacos by layering jackfruit and spicy slaw on each tortilla. Add sliced avocado and a squeeze of fresh lime if desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Classic Mac and Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, melt 1/4 cup butter over medium heat.
Stir in flour and cook for about 1 minute until bubbly.
Gradually whisk in milk and cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar and Parmesan cheese until melted.
Add cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce and mix well. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour into a greased baking dish.
In a small pan, melt 2 tablespoons butter and toss with breadcrumbs. Sprinkle over the macaroni.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until bubbly and golden on top.
Let it cool slightly before serving.

title: Mediterranean Stuffed Mini Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Wash the mini peppers, slice off the tops, and carefully remove the seeds without tearing the peppers.
In a mixing bowl, combine feta cheese, cooked quinoa, Kalamata olives, sun-dried tomatoes, and parsley.
Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice over the mixture, then season with salt and pepper. Mix gently to combine.
Spoon the filling into each hollowed mini pepper, packing it gently but not overflowing.
Place stuffed peppers upright on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until the peppers are tender and the filling is warmed through.
Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly before transferring to a serving platter.
Garnish with extra parsley if desired.
Serve warm or at room temperature as a colorful, flavorful appetizer.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Jalapeño Poppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a bowl, mix cream cheese, shredded cheddar, and garlic powder until smooth.
Spoon the cheese mixture into each jalapeño half.
Wrap each stuffed jalapeño half with a half slice of bacon and secure with a toothpick.
Place poppers on a baking sheet lined with foil or parchment paper.
Bake for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until bacon is crispy and jalapeños are tender.
Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Szechuan Beef
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Szechuan peppercorns, toasted and ground
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add garlic, ginger, and dried chilies; stir-fry until fragrant.
Add sliced beef and cook until browned.
Stir in chili bean paste, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and ground Szechuan peppercorns.
Cook for another 3–4 minutes until beef is well coated and sauce thickens.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms with Sausage and Cheese
ingredients: 24 large white mushrooms, stems removed and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.
Add chopped mushroom stems and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, mix cooked sausage mixture with cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs, and parsley. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon filling into mushroom caps and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until mushrooms are tender and tops are golden.
Serve warm as an appetizer.

title: Dan Dan Noodles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Sichuan peppercorn oil or chili oil
2 teaspoons sesame paste or peanut butter
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add garlic and ginger; sauté until fragrant.
Add ground pork and cook until browned.
In a bowl, mix soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame paste, sugar, and chili oil.
Toss noodles with sauce mixture.
Top with cooked pork, green onions, and chopped peanuts.
Serve warm.

title: Curd Rice
instructions: Mash the cooled cooked rice gently with a spoon or your hand.
Add whisked curd and milk to the rice. Mix well to combine.
Add salt to taste and mix again.
In a small pan, heat oil over medium flame.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal and fry until golden.
Add dried red chilies, green chilies, ginger, and curry leaves. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Pour the tempering over the curd rice mixture and mix gently.
Garnish with chopped coriander, grated carrot, and pomegranate seeds if using.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound boneless chicken breasts or thighs, cut into strips
1 teaspoon chili paste or sriracha (optional for heat)
instructions: In a bowl, mix soy sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, garlic, coriander, and turmeric. Add chicken strips and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread chicken onto soaked bamboo skewers.
Heat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Grill chicken skewers for 3–4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Meanwhile, whisk together all peanut sauce ingredients until smooth, adding more water to reach desired consistency.
Serve chicken satay hot with peanut sauce on the side for dipping.

title: Baked Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
ingredients: 1 large head of cauliflower, cut into bite-sized florets
Ranch or blue cheese dressing, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly grease it.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, water, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and salt until a smooth batter forms.
Add cauliflower florets to the batter and toss until each piece is evenly coated.
Arrange the coated florets in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the batter is set and lightly golden.
While cauliflower bakes, mix hot sauce and melted butter in a small bowl to create the buffalo sauce.
Remove cauliflower from the oven and toss the baked florets gently in the buffalo sauce until well coated.
Return coated cauliflower to the baking sheet and bake for an additional 10–15 minutes, until crispy and slightly caramelized.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Garnish with chopped green onions if desired.
Serve warm with ranch or blue cheese dressing for dipping.

title: Cajun Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Toss shrimp with Cajun seasoning until evenly coated.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook until pink and cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove shrimp and set aside.
In the same skillet, add butter and garlic; sauté until fragrant (about 1 minute).
Stir in heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Add Parmesan cheese and stir until sauce thickens slightly. Season with salt and pepper.
Return shrimp to the skillet, toss to coat in sauce.
Add cooked pasta and mix well.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: One-Pot Pasta
instructions: In a large pot, combine pasta, water/broth, cherry tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat and simmer until pasta is cooked and water is mostly absorbed (about 10-12 minutes).
Stir well, garnish with fresh herbs and Parmesan if desired. Serve hot.

title: Meatloaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, onion, milk, egg, garlic, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, and thyme. Mix well but do not overwork.
Shape the mixture into a loaf and place in a baking pan.
Spread ketchup evenly over the top of the meatloaf.
Bake for 1 hour or until cooked through (internal temperature should reach 160°F / 71°C).
Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
